description: Design a precision V-Block jig in FreeCAD. Create a 60mm x 60mm x 40mm rectangular block. Add a V-groove on the top face (Z=40) running along the Y-axis, centered on X=0. The groove should have a 90-degree included angle and its bottom vertex must be at Z=28mm (12mm deep). Add two rectangular clamping slots on the left and right sides (X-min and X-max faces), running along the Y-axis. The slots should be 12mm high (centered at Z=20mm) and 4mm deep. Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/v_block.FCStd'.
